# Psalm 103 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. Bless O-my-soul YHWH, and-all my-inward-parts his-holy name.

**2** Bless O-my-soul YHWH, and-do-not forget all his-benefits:

**3** The-one-forgiving all your-iniquity, the-one-healing all your-diseases,

**4** The-one-redeeming from-the-pit your-life, the-one-crowning-you steadfast-love and-compassion,

**5** The-one-satisfying with-good your-ornament; renews like-the-eagle your-youth.

**6** Doing righteousness YHWH, and-judgments for-all the-oppressed.

**7** He-made-known his-ways to-Moses, to-sons-of Israel his-deeds.

**8** Compassionate and-gracious YHWH, slow-of anger and-abundant-in-steadfast-love.

**9** Not to-forever he-will-contend, and-not to-perpetuity he-will-keep-anger.

**10** Not according-to our-sins he-has-done to-us, and-not according-to our-iniquities he-has-repaid to-us.

**11** For as-height-of heavens above the-earth, great his-steadfast-love over those-fearing-him.

**12** As-far-as east from west, he-has-removed from-us our-transgressions.

**13** As-compassion-of a-father over children, has-compassion YHWH over those-fearing-him.

**14** For he knows our-frame; remembering that dust we-are.

**15** Man — like-grass his-days; like-a-flower-of the-field so he-flourishes.

**16** For the-wind passes over-it and-it-is-gone, and-not knows-it again its-place.

**17** And-steadfast-love-of YHWH from-everlasting and-to everlasting upon those-fearing-him, and-his-righteousness to-children's children,

**18** To-those-keeping his-covenant, and-to-those-remembering his-precepts to-do-them.

**19** YHWH in-the-heavens has-established his-throne, and-his-kingdom over-all rules.

**20** Bless YHWH his-angels, mighty-ones-of strength doers-of his-word, to-listen to-voice-of his-word.

**21** Bless YHWH all his-hosts, his-ministers doers-of his-will.

**22** Bless YHWH all his-works, in-all places-of his-dominion. Bless O-my-soul YHWH.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **103:8**: Direct quotation of Exodus 34:6 — the foundational divine self-revelation. This verse is the theological center of the psalm.

- **103:12**: 'As-far-as east from west' — infinite distance (east and west never meet); the most vivid OT image of total forgiveness.

- **103:14**: 'Remembering that dust we-are' — echoes Genesis 2:7; God's compassion is grounded in knowing our fragility.

— EMET
